class Node:
    def __init__(self, val):
        self.val, self.next = val, None

def get_intersection(a, b):
    p, q = a, b
    while p is not q:
        p = p.next if p else b
        q = q.next if q else a
    return p

shared = Node(8)
shared.next = Node(10)
a = Node(3); a.next = Node(7); a.next.next = shared
b = Node(99); b.next = shared
node = get_intersection(a, b)
print(node.val if node else None)
